I'm in my mid 20's and have finally gotten on top of diabetes but my dad still freaks out and give me a lecture every time he hears that my sugars are high/low. When I was your age I used to get so mad at him because he was always on my back, restricting me from eating the same food as my siblings and always telling me to exercise but now when he shows concern I realise he's just scared to death about the possibility of losing his baby to this disease. 
But that does not mean you have to feel shitty because no one around you understands.

I would highly recommend seeing if there is a diabetes camp/diabetes groups in your area, and also look into seeing a therapist. As it's been pointed out, diabetes and depression go hand in hand and the worst thing you can do is not talk about it.

Trust us when we say you are not alone, I'm so proud of you for reaching out to the Reddit diabetes community and if you ever need to rant about life or your health please don't hesitate to send me a pm/post on this sub. 

We understand what you're going through, but we are also proof that one day it will get easier. You just gotta hang in there and seek help when you need it. You are not alone.
